Description:


We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (TypeScript-First) with 7 to 8 years of experience to join our high-autonomy engineering team. In this role, your primary strength will be building resilient, production-grade systems using React and NestJS, paired with a solid capability in Python to handle data-heavy workloads, scripts, and service integrations.

We operate in an agentic engineering environment. This means our small, impactful teams own problems end-to-end, actively leverage AI agents within our workflows to supercharge velocity, and maintain a rigorous TDD (Test-Driven Development) discipline to ensure quality never takes a backseat to speed. If you thrive in high-trust, fast-moving environments and pride yourself on writing clean, robust code across both Node.js and browser environments, we want to talk to you.


Requirements:

Experience: 7–8 years of full-stack engineering experience delivering enterprise-grade or high-traffic web applications.
Frontend Excellence: Deep mastery of React and its modern ecosystem (React Query, Zustand, React Hook Form, React Router, Vite, and data-dense UI tools like AG Grid).
Backend Versatility: Expert in TypeScript/NestJS, alongside professional proficiency in Python (comfortable using Pytest, writing clean APIs, and handling data integrations).
DevOps & Cloud-Native Fluency: Practical experience containerizing applications with Docker, deploying to Kubernetes, and managing pipelines via GitLab CI/CD (ideally within GCP).
Testing Rigor: Proven track record with testing frameworks such as Jest, Pytest, and Playwright for robust E2E validation.
Nice-to-Have Skills: Experience with data visualization libraries like D3.js, Recharts, or Vega is a major plus.

Job Responsibilities:

Feature Delivery: Design, build, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using React on the frontend and NestJS / Python on the backend.
Architecture & Schema Design: Architect robust relational database schemas and optimize complex queries for PostgreSQL and MySQL via Prisma.
Quality & TDD: Lead by example with strict TDD practices, writing comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to maintain bulletproof CI-integrated quality gates.
Integration & Data Work: Develop, maintain, and optimize production-grade Python services and scripts for data processing and external system integrations.
System Performance: Ensure high reliability, optimal performance, and smooth asynchronous programming flows across Node.js runtime and client-side application states.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Data, and DevOps teams to scope features, refine system architecture, and continuously deploy cloud-native systems.

What We Offer:


Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
